name: Gymship
subtitle: Find a time your crew can actually work out.
description: Sideload Gymship with FlareStore, AltStore, SideStore, or Feather. After you add this source, download the IPA and sign it with your own Apple ID — no paid developer account required. Sign in uses Google, so it works after you re-sign.

apps.name: Gymship
apps.subtitle: Shared free time, turned into a workout.
apps.localizedDescription: Gymship reads when you're busy (never why), syncs that with a crew of up to five, and proposes times you can all train. iOS 27 Liquid Glass, built to be gentle on iPhone Air.

versions.localizedDescription: The weekly goal minus and plus are the same size, and the week dial fills more of iPhone Air.
Icon tiles, badges, avatars and crew crests now match the color you pick in Appearance.
Snappier animations, a Messages-style Agent composer, and toggles for hours and rest days.
Official Sign in with Google button. Creates your Gymship account in Supabase.
Sign in with Google so sideloaded builds can create an account.
Built for iPhone Air: concentric surfaces, a settling mesh background, and suggestions that pause in Low Power Mode.

privacy.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: Gymship reads your calendars to find when you're busy and schedules your confirmed workout sessions on a dedicated Workout calendar.
